description: A function call key in a static map can't be analyzed as a static call
notes: The spec returns each key as an expression without further interpretation, so a key written as a function call can be analyzed as a static call. hashicorp/hcl wraps every key in an ObjectConsKeyExpr (hclsyntax/expression.go), whose only static analysis method is AsTraversal. Its UnwrapExpression method returns hclsyntax.Expression instead of hcl.Expression, so it doesn't satisfy the interface that hcl.UnwrapExpressionUntil looks for, and hcl.ExprCall can't reach the key's expression.
reference_error: A static function call is required
